content.text:
I migrated all 440 `<app-pill>` usages to the v2 API with the migration tool, and `npx ngc -p tsconfig.json` now reports no errors.

The tool made 2680 edits across 170 files. It also added the `PillTonePipe` import to the 80 components that needed it.

The v1 to v2 changes were:
- **`variant`:** renamed to `tone`. String literals were rewritten to the new values (`info` to `neutral`, `success` to `positive`, `warning` to `caution`), and runtime values go through `pillTone`.
- **`disableTooltip`:** replaced by `tooltip`, with the value negated.
- **`label`:** no longer an input; its value now goes in the element content.

I haven't rendered any of the pills in a browser.
